item.title: Connected data keeps moving
item.summary: Murph now keeps delayed wearable imports moving alongside routine background work, helping connected activity and health data reach follow-up work without repeated delay.
item.details: Recovery stays bounded so retained imports can catch up without holding up other background work. Murph may need more than one pass to work through the backlog, and it does not mark data processed until the import succeeds or reaches a confirmed failure.
